jobs.title: Advisor, Business Strategy - AI Enablement
jobs.location: New Hyde Park, NY · On-site/health system
jobs.why: Exceptional healthcare operations, training, automation, and program-enablement match. The role builds enterprise AI education, adoption programs, reporting/KPIs, platform rollouts, stakeholder coordination, and scalable operational processes across a major health system.
jobs.gap: Northwell asks for 5–7 years of relevant experience and prefers broad AI/platform familiarity. Emphasize healthcare operations, training, workflow automation, Microsoft systems, reporting, and practical AI enablement without overstating technical AI depth.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.why: Very strong mental-health operations fit in a company focused on insurance, provider administration, credentialing, claims, payment workflows, and scaling access to care. Strong overlap with healthcare operations, systems/process improvement, reporting, and cross-functional execution.
jobs.gap: This is a broader strategic operations role and may expect deeper quantitative modeling or high-growth startup experience. Keep SQL at foundational/working level and lead with healthcare workflows, automation, reporting, and operational problem solving.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Manager
jobs.why: Excellent behavioral-health operations match involving clinical workflows, provider quality, scalable programs, Salesforce/BI tools, cross-functional execution, and data-driven operational improvement.
jobs.gap: The role favors high-growth health-tech experience and stronger analytics depth. Position SQL only as foundational/working knowledge and emphasize healthcare operations, CRM/process systems, reporting, and execution.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Strong healthcare-technology implementation role involving executive, operational, clinical, and technical stakeholders. Excellent overlap with onboarding, workflow implementation, documentation, training, troubleshooting, and cross-functional healthcare operations.
jobs.gap: Arcadia works with complex healthcare data and enterprise client implementations, so deeper payer/provider data-platform experience may be preferred. Emphasize hands-on healthcare systems work and implementation ownership.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Digital-health implementation role with strong overlap in client launches, project planning, requirements gathering, stakeholder coordination, onboarding, process improvement, and healthcare operations.
jobs.gap: The salary ceiling is closer to the minimum target than other roles, and direct digital-health implementation experience is preferred. Lead with healthcare workflow, onboarding, systems, and project ownership experience.

jobs.title: Advisor, Business Strategy - AI Strategy
jobs.why: Strong healthcare transformation role combining AI strategy, operational efficiency, use-case evaluation, vendor assessment, program execution, and collaboration across business, clinical, operational, and technical teams.
jobs.gap: This version of the Northwell role leans more heavily into AI strategy, governance, vendor diligence, and business-case analysis. It is a stretch versus the AI Enablement opening, so emphasize operational automation and systems implementation rather than deep AI governance expertise.

jobs.title: Revenue Strategy & Operations Manager (Insights & AI)
jobs.why: Strong health-tech growth-operations option centered on AI-enabled workflows, reporting infrastructure, analytics, operational cadences, and cross-functional revenue execution.
jobs.gap: The posting expects fluent SQL/data modeling and traditional strategy/operations experience. SQL should remain described only as foundational/working knowledge, making this a higher-upside stretch application.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.why: Strong systems-heavy business operations role covering tool implementation, process design, GTM operations, cross-functional projects, quantitative analysis, and scaling a high-growth technology company.
jobs.gap: Modal asks for 5+ years in a business function plus exposure to coding and deeper pricing/finance analysis. Emphasize systems fluency, workflow automation, reporting, implementation, and fast learning.

jobs.title: Sr. Strategy & Operations Manager, Psych
jobs.why: High-upside behavioral-health strategy and operations role with direct relevance to mental-health services, scalable operating models, partnerships, cross-functional execution, and healthcare growth strategy.
jobs.gap: This is a senior stretch role and includes corporate development, partnerships, and adjacent-market evaluation that go beyond the strongest current experience. Apply selectively and avoid overstating strategy or M&A depth.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.location: New York, NY · Hybrid (3+ days in office)
jobs.why: High-paying systems and business-operations role centered on solving operational friction, scaling cross-functional systems, launching initiatives, defining metrics, and working closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, and GTM teams.
jobs.gap: The role explicitly asks for 4+ years in top-tier consulting/BizOps/VC/PE/founder-type experience and expects independent SQL querying. This is a stretch; SQL should remain foundational/working and the tenure requirement should not be overstated.
